profile.headline: Robotics for a Better World
profile.summary:
Engineer with broad software and design experience that’s passionate about robotics, software, automation, and computer vision. Ten years of experience specializing in robotic software, high-fidelity simulations, and electromechanical systems.

Currently combining my passions of robotics and green technologies to help Canopii achieve its mission of sustainable, autonomous greenhouses.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead the architecture of software and automation systems for fully autonomous greenhouse systems
• Develop software in C++, Python, and ROS 2 for robotics and industrial automation equipment
• Design and build electrical control systems, including component selection and optimization
• Integrate industrial automation technologies, including PLCs, PCs, motors, sensors, and digital/analog I/O
• Serve as Project Director (PD) for AI/ML-focused grant proposals submitted to the USDA AFRI program
• Contribute to core engineering strategy and business decision-making for an early-stage startup
positions.insights: Skills: Robot Operating System (ROS) · Python (Programming Language) · C++ · Robotics · Sustainable Agriculture

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• Produced physics simulations in IsaacSim, Unreal Engine, and ROS for high-fidelity Digital Twins
• Developed software in C, C++, Python, and ST for use in simulations and industrial machines
• Designed and implemented kinematics and path planners for serial and non-serial manipulators
• Supported industrial automation (PLCs, motion controllers, servo drives, industrial PCs, and I/O)
• Programmed human-machine interfaces using HTML, Javascript, and CSS
positions.insights: Skills: Simulation Software · C++ · Linux · Computer Science · Systems Engineering · Computer Simulations · Unit Testing · Algorithm Development · Python (Programming Language) · Full-Stack Development · Software Development · Robotics · Motion Planning · Embedded Systems · Debugging · Robot Operating System (ROS) · Rust (Programming Language) · Modeling and Simulation · Kinematics

positions.title: Mechanical and Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Researched and implemented new products including autonomous collaborative robots
• Architected, designed, and implemented software for precision automation equipment
• Designed complex electro-mechanical systems including robotics, vision, and precision motion
• Created concepts for new automation projects
• Interacted with customers regularly through weekly project reviews
positions.insights: Skills: Mechanical Engineering · Computer Science · Systems Engineering · Unit Testing · Algorithm Development · Software Development · Robotics · Embedded Systems · Debugging · Modeling and Simulation

positions.title: Automation Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Utilized Six Sigma training to improve yields for factory automation
• Participated in Continuous Improvement events to find inefficiencies in manufacturing operation
• Designed tooling for a new product series of chainsaw components
• Performed cost analysis on the redesign of multi-million dollar chain assembly machines

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and tested new software features in a .NET environment for six axis robots
• Helped create path planning software and an inverse kinematic solver for multi-axis robots
• Researched new hardware designs and implemented them using CAD/CAM software Fusion 360
• Designed, programmed, and tested a servo controlled turntable using C++
• Extended serial communications C++ libraries to communicate to external I/O devices
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Algorithm Development · Full-Stack Development · Software Development · Robotics · Embedded Systems · Debugging · Modeling and Simulation · Kinematics

positions.title: Custom Products Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed hydraulic forklift attachments to achieve rigid customer requirements
• Worked with Siemens Solid Edge/NX/PLM software to accomplish projects on time and budget
• Updated components, sensors, and controls architecture for hydraulic force control systems
• Facilitated technical communication between custom design team, manufacturing, and sales
• Created Excel VBA based productivity tools for improving lead times on new designs
